# How we're helping creators disclose altered or synthetic content
The YouTube Team

Mar 18, 2024[[read-time]] minute read

### Share
Copy link

But viewers increasingly want more transparency about whether the content they’re seeing is altered or synthetic.

That’s why today, we're introducing a new tool in Creator Studio requiring creators to disclose to viewers when realistic content – content a viewer could easily mistake for a real person, place, scene, or event – is made with altered or synthetic media, including generative AI. We’re not requiring creators to disclose content that is clearly unrealistic, animated, includes special effects, or has used generative AI for production assistance.

![YouTube disclosure on AI generated content](https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-uniblog-publish-prod/images/blog-gtm-web-disclosure_2x.max-100x100.format-webp.webp)

![YouTube disclosure on AI generated content in player](https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-uniblog-publish-prod/images/blog-gtm-shorts_2x_1.max-100x100.format-webp.webp)

- **Using the likeness of a realistic person:** Digitally altering content to replace the face of one individual with another's or synthetically generating a person’s voice to narrate a video.
- **Generating realistic scenes:** Showing a realistic depiction of fictional major events, like a tornado moving toward a real town.

We also won’t require creators to disclose when synthetic media is unrealistic and/or the changes are inconsequential.

- Clearly unrealistic content, such as animation or someone riding a unicorn through a fantastical world

![YouTube disclosure of AI generated content on the expanded description box.](https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-uniblog-publish-prod/images/blog-gtm_sd_2x_1.max-100x100.format-webp.webp)

## More like this
[![How we're helping creators disclose altered or synthetic content](https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-uniblog-publish-prod/images/BINK_YouTube_SqueezebackUI_Sket.max-290x290.format-webp.webp)](https://blog.youtube/inside-youtube/our-approach-to-responsible-ai-innovation/)

In parallel, as we previously announced, we’re continuing to work towards an updated privacy process for people to request the removal of AI-generated or other synthetic or altered content that simulates an identifiable individual, including their face or voice.

[![How we're helping creators disclose altered or synthetic content](https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-uniblog-publish-prod/images/BINK_YouTube_SqueezebackUI_Sket.max-290x290.format-webp.webp)](https://blog.youtube/inside-youtube/our-approach-to-responsible-ai-innovation/)

web.title: YouTube Altered or Synthetic Content Disclosure Policy: Official 2026 Guide
web.description:
# YouTube Altered or Synthetic Content Disclosure
As a result, YouTube has developed new YouTube altered or synthetic content disclosure policies to help its viewers.

## New YouTube altered or synthetic content labels
You’ll then know how to tell if the videos you are watching contain altered or synthetically generated content.

YouTube says that the purpose of these new requirements is for “creators to disclose to viewers when realistic content – content a viewer could easily mistake for a real person, place, scene, or event – is made with altered or synthetic media, including generative AI.”

## What types of YouTube altered or synthetic content must be disclosed?
- Makes a real person appear to say or do something they didn’t do – such as when a creator digitally replaces the face of one individual with another’s or synthetically generates a person’s voice to say something the person didn’t actually say.
- Generates a realistic-looking scene that didn’t actually occur – such as showing a realistic depiction of fictional major events, like a fictional tornado moving toward a real town.

## What types of altered content does NOT have to be disclosed?
- Audio improvements

## How do you disclose that your video has altered content?
- If you select “YES,” then your video will include a label in your video description saying that the content has been altered or is synthetic.

To be clear, you are permitted to use altered or synthetic content.
